blocks.html: Engagement Rate is a performance metric that measures the level of interaction prospects or customers have with marketing content.

Engagement rate indicates how actively an audience interacts with content across channels such as social media, email, websites, and digital campaigns. It helps businesses assess the effectiveness of their content in capturing attention and driving meaningful interactions.
Engagement rate is calculated by comparing total interactions to the total audience or impressions. A common formula is:
Measures content effectiveness and audience interest
Helps optimize marketing strategies and messaging
Supports better ROI from marketing campaigns
The exact calculation can vary depending on the platform and campaign goals.
A social media post receives 500 interactions (likes, comments, shares) from 10,000 impressions, resulting in an engagement rate of 5%, indicating strong audience interaction.
Engagement rate is a key metric for understanding how well your content resonates with your audience. Higher engagement signals stronger interest and better chances of driving conversions.
